On the display of the car

Android Auto shows apps of this kind only when Google Play installed them. An APK installed by hand works on the phone, but stays hidden in the car whatever the settings.

The dependable way: create the app in your own Google Play Console, upload the .aab file of the release to internal testing with yourself as the tester, and install it from the Play Store. Uninstall this copy first, and from then on update only through Play.

After installing, connect the phone to the car again.

Asks the engine control unit for every value known from Volkswagen group cars and notes down what it answers. This is how values that are missing above, such as the oil pressure, get found. It takes a few minutes and the gauges stand still meanwhile, so do it parked.\n\nTake one reading with the engine idling, another while holding about 3000 rpm, and if you can a third with the engine warm. Then share the record below.
Copy or share the record of what the app and the adapter said to each other. It tells what the car supports and where things went wrong.
